description: Count characters with and without spaces, words and lines in real time, with a live X/Twitter 280-character limit gauge and SMS segment indicator.

faqs.a: A standard post on X/Twitter allows up to 280 characters. The gauge shows how many you have left and warns you when you go over.
A single SMS holds 160 standard characters (70 if you use emoji or non-Latin script). Longer messages are split into 153- or 67-character segments.
Yes. Once the page loads, all counting runs locally in your browser.

howto: Type or paste your text into the box.
Character stats update live as you type.
Watch the X/Twitter gauge to stay within 280 characters.
Check the SMS line to see how many message segments you need.
title: Character Counter
